title: High-Protein Scrambled Eggs with Cottage Cheese
description: Whole eggs blended with cottage cheese for extra-creamy, extra-protein scrambled eggs.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese until mostly smooth.
Cook low and slow in a non-stick pan, stirring gently.
Fold through herbs or spinach just before serving.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste high-protein scrambled eggs

notes: Cottage cheese melts into the eggs as they cook, adding protein without any noticeable texture change.
